payload.title: Cooling with Outside Air
payload.full_text:
1) Where Article 5.2.2.7. applies to a proposed building's HVAC system, the HVAC systems of the corresponding thermal blocks in the reference building shall be modeled in accordance with that Article and Table 8.4.4.12.
Table 8.4.4.12.
Applicable Requirements for Cooling with Outside Air According to Type of HVAC System Forming Part of Sentence 8.4.4.12.(1)
Notes to Table 8.4.4.12.:
(1) See Table 8.4.4.7.-B.
(2) See Table 8.4.4.13.
